conclusion: No consequential errors or important omissions found.
scope: Original 2017 WizKids ten-page SC_Rule Book_061017_Web5; all nine original species including Faderan reverse; accepted original printed phase/relic components; contemporaneous direct designer clarification separately labeled. Printed-card input/output quantities may still be read from components.

independence.allowed_provenance_only: Read the five manifest-listed retrieval/crop provenance files and designer primary provenance/raw-author records; did not open other files in their directories. Incidental references within authorized provenance are not authority.

coverage.heading: Metadata, Overview, Components and reading cards
coverage.checks: Player count/time, six-turn objective and tie, original edition exclusions, component classes, resource identities and sizes, nominal values, visibility, piece limits, card ownership and entry/upgrade symbols.

coverage.heading: Setup
coverage.checks: Species selection order, printed starts, stars and fixed Kt pairs, unshuffled libraries, initial colony/research allocation, Kjas double colony track and two starts, era deck ordering, count-dependent tracks/bonuses, species pieces and Faderan numerical example.

coverage.heading: Turn Structure
coverage.checks: Five ordinary Trade/Economy/sharing/bidding rounds, final sixth Trade and final Economy, sharing without bidding, total phase counts, final count-dependent 2/1/0 bonuses and Yengii zero, loans, final theft.
source_citations: Designer article 26690049, 2017-08-20; designer article 26803262, 2017-09-01 (separate primary clarifications)

coverage.heading: Trade and binding agreements
coverage.checks: Goods, timing, consent and binding contingent/multilateral/future obligations; inability, agreed compensation and exact penalty table/negative scores; temporary species-background loans, permanent colonies/research, phase end and immediate Trade actions.

coverage.heading: Inventing, violet converters and upgrades
coverage.checks: One alternative input set, invention points immediately, delayed sharing bonus and matching card; out-of-play entry exception; resource-paid loan upgrades versus owner-possession for named-card route; hidden spent cards/identity changes; climate and colony destination.

coverage.heading: Economy, donations, sharing
coverage.checks: Colony-support timing, optional once-per-turn economic converters, simultaneous inputs/outputs including points/ships, production procedure and no negotiation; donation area/next Trade/gifts and final retention; per-invention sharing, Yengii and era-IV exceptions.

coverage.heading: Bidding
coverage.checks: Public ship total, two committed secret bids plus reserves, colony before research reveal, descending opportunity, full successful bid payment/pass retention/minimum limits, support later, ties, brief binding negotiation, minimum-1 cleanup/slide/refill.

coverage.heading: Scoring
coverage.checks: Retained final donations, output size shortcut, earned points plus independent complete resource-category groups (octagon / two large / three small-or-ships), half-point precision, reveal/high score/no tiebreak, excluded optional twelfths.

coverage.heading: Caylion
coverage.checks: Halved fractional colony bids only; correct seedling acquisition, two simultaneous economic uses, no doubling upgrade cost, persistence through flip/trade and removal on discard; Trade upgrade yellow output.
source_citations: /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/batches/2026-11-05-batch-002957/source-preflight/sidereal-confluence/species-sheet-01-front.png Halved Colonization Bids / Seedling Tokens / Upgrading the Caylion Economy

coverage.heading: Eni Et
coverage.checks: Same-color interest inputs/outputs, prohibition on own upgraded/unupgraded interest use, loan/upgrade permission; exact wild pass-through and no additional wild production, mixed/only wild cases and example.

coverage.heading: Faderan
coverage.checks: Acknowledgment trade/return/point sequence per invention; one shuffled relic-deck converter once per turn and printed input; ordinary relic loan and entry rewards; all eight sheet-reverse relic exceptions, detector nontradeability and entry points from actual cards; Star’s Ruin Sharing Bonus terminology verified against printed card.
source_citations: /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/sidereal-confluence/2026-11-05-batch-002957/source-review/timing-specialist/component-9-front.jpg printed relic atlas, including deck-back input, Gift, Cache, Paradise and entry rewards

coverage.heading: Im’dril
coverage.checks: Fleet support assignment/division/combination, necessary loan support and no support for ordinary borrowed cards, discovering fleets and star start, no ordinary Colony Support and Automated Transport exception.

coverage.heading: Kjasjavikalimm
coverage.checks: Split timing and equal halves, later ranks, full half purchase/pass, no second split and updated colony tiebreak; setup count; territory entry/upgrade/loan/two converters.

coverage.heading: Kt’Zr’Kt’Rtl
coverage.checks: Exact depicted three pairs, inseparability and independent upgrades, pair loans; nullspace entry/no other output/permanent trade/removal on consumption; unlimited support and colony-only first tie priority plus infinite final tiebreak.
source_citations: /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/batches/2026-11-05-batch-002957/source-preflight/sidereal-confluence/species-sheet-06-front.png Nonlinear Thinking / Nullspace Drive / Boundless Expansion / Dangerously Fast

coverage.heading: Unity
coverage.checks: Gray same-size wilds and mixed colors, not exchanging to ordinary resources, theft immunity and interest pass-through; flexible input; any-climate colonization, four computer worlds, one support and excess check.
source_citations: /home/jonny/projects/boardgame-rules/docs/quality/summary-qa/batches/2026-11-05-batch-002957/source-preflight/sidereal-confluence/species-sheet-07-front.png Flexible Output / Flexible Input / Flexible Colonization / Computer Worlds

coverage.heading: Yengii
coverage.checks: Secret inventions versus normal receipt of others’ inventions; retained splay and reduced right bonus; exclusion of inventions from research-team count; permanent matching licenses in same Trade, hidden cards cannot return.

coverage.heading: Zeth
coverage.checks: Envoys bundle and obligatory token, trade-only separate tokens and no secondary transfers; red steal timing, single target and maximum one converter per target, shortage and shape/size, envoy alternative does not consume tokens, wild immunity, actual trades/gifts distinction for protection.

coverage.heading: Separately labeled designer FAQ
coverage.checks: Normal final Economy and exact input colors, simultaneous no chaining, donations retained, final sharing before score and no bidding; final theft as final action with actual input colors; optional no-final-theft suggestion expressly excluded.

coverage.heading: Player Reference and source note
coverage.checks: Condensed procedures agree with substantive rules and exceptions; primary printed sources distinguished from module behavior and designer clarification.
source_citations: All nine species fronts; original Faderan reverse; printed component and designer sources above

authority_assessment.rulebook: Native PDF inspected in full (all ten pages) and compared with complete extraction. Page1/10 author and 2017 copyright establish edition; all manifest hashes match.
authority_assessment.species: All nine exact fronts and original Faderan reverse visually read. Art/layout/text agree with original rulebook setup facsimiles and supplied 2017 nine-sheet / 2019 Faderan component images. Filenames do not determine rules; actual raster content does.
authority_assessment.recovered_components: Immutable Steam CDN asset content IDs and hashes in accepted retrieval provenance bind original printed atlases. Their printed typography, numbering /396 and original book p4 fronts/p9 Turn2 reverse corroborate original lineage. Native crops were inspected individually and exact pixel crop/parent hash validation passed for all 15 provenance-listed crops. Module URLs supply asset provenance only; no module behavior used.
authority_assessment.designer: Raw article26690049 author1220373 dated2017-08-20 and article26803262 author1220373 dated2017-09-01; profile identifies TauCetiDD / TauCeti Deichmann with designer25517, matching original booklet credit. Direct author bodies support FAQ. Other users and quoted commentary excluded as independent authority; optional house-rule sentence distinguished from official answer.
authority_assessment.non_authoritative_candidates: Other recovered-component-provenance entries explicitly labeled unused discovery candidates were not used to infer phase sequence or other rules.
